nodes.name: build_article_request
nodes.notes: Joins the two fetched prompt files into the session request; no instruction is authored here.

nodes.name: request_article
nodes.notes: A refused turn is data: neverError turns 4xx/5xx into a response parse_article names, instead of a run that ends with no reason.

nodes.name: fetch_article
nodes.notes: The adapter writes article.md in the session directory; the draft is the artifact, not the chat answer.

nodes.name: fetch_sources
nodes.notes: The rewritten ledger carries the server's found/excerpt/status fields; the gate checks the article against it.
